headlines.title: Trending: Take-Two Interactive price ascends as 'Grand Theft Auto VI' is teased
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance's Brooke DiPalma tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including PayPal (PYPL), Marvell Technology, Inc. (MRVL), and Take-Two Interactive (TTWO), whose price rose after a 30-minute preview of Grand Theft Auto VI video was released.

headlines.title: Why PayPal Stock Just Crashed
headlines.summary: PayPal was for sale. Now it's not.

headlines.title: PayPal (PYPL) Bid Withdrawal Ends $50 Billion Takeover Proposal
headlines.summary: PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS: PYPL) is no longer the target of a proposed US$50b acquisition after Advent and Stripe withdrew their joint bid. The bidders have formally dropped their offer, leaving PayPal to continue as an independent company. The decision removes a potential change of control event that some investors had been watching closely.

headlines.title: Marvell, Nvidia, PayPal, Workday, Iren, Elastic, Pasqal, Affirm, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
headlines.summary: Marvell drops after so-so earnings fail to wow investors, while PayPal slumps after a report says its takeover may be off.

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
